text.zh: 在利物浦郊区一所小学读书，是该校被选中拍片的两个男孩之一。
text.en: Attends a primary school in a Liverpool suburb, one of two boys chosen from it for the film.

text.zh: 7 岁时他想当宇航员，当不成就当长途汽车司机。
text.en: At seven he wants to be an astronaut, or failing that a coach driver.

text.zh: 住在利物浦郊区，他说比起乡下更喜欢住在城里。
text.en: Lives in a Liverpool suburb and says he prefers living in town to the country.

text.zh: 他想象自己开大巴载人去乡下和海边，用喇叭告诉乘客到了哪里。
text.en: Pictures himself driving coach trips to the country and seaside, telling passengers over a loudspeaker where they are.

text.zh: 和朋友 Peter 一样，在利物浦郊区当地的综合中学上学。
text.en: Attends a local comprehensive school in his Liverpool suburb, like his friend Peter.

text.zh: 仍想当长途汽车司机，他说这与自己想去旅行有关。
text.en: Still interested in being a coach driver, which he links to wanting to travel.

text.zh: 住在利物浦郊区。
text.en: Lives in a Liverpool suburb.

text.zh: 升入综合中学，起初觉得学校大得多，很难适应。
text.en: Has moved up to a comprehensive school, which he found much bigger and hard to settle into at first.

text.zh: 在利物浦的综合中学考得四门 A-level，后读了一学期便离开阿伯丁大学。
text.en: Got four A-levels at a Liverpool comprehensive, then walked out of Aberdeen University after one term.

text.zh: 在伦敦的建筑工地打零工。
text.en: Doing casual labour on a building site in London.

text.zh: 父母都是教师；他说只要父母让他按自己的方式生活，就能相处得好。
text.en: Both his parents are teachers; he says he gets on with them if they let him live his own way.

text.zh: 住在伦敦一处擅自占住的空房里。
text.en: Lives in a squat in London.

text.zh: 1975 年底离开阿伯丁大学，来到伦敦想重新开始生活。
text.en: Left Aberdeen University at the end of 1975 and moved to London to start a new life.

text.zh: 他说自己从未有过可反抗的安稳：“我这辈子一直在半空中乱踢。”
text.en: Says he never had stability to kick against: "I've been kicking in mid-air the whole of my life."

text.zh: 有十门 O-level 和四门 A-level；读了一学期便从阿伯丁大学辍学。
text.en: Has ten O levels and four A levels; dropped out of Aberdeen University after one term.

text.zh: 已失业三年，靠社会救济金生活；上一份工作是在青年旅舍做饭。
text.en: Unemployed for three years and living on social security; his last job was cooking in a youth hostel.

text.zh: 经历一段艰难时期后已与父母和好；他一直告诉自己永远不要孩子。
text.en: Has made up quite well with his parents after bad times; he always told himself he would never have children.

text.zh: 居无定所：在北威尔士农场度过夏天后，刚到苏格兰西部高地。
text.en: No settled home: after a summer on a North Wales farm, he has just arrived in Scotland's Western Highlands.

text.zh: 过去七年一直在英国各地漂泊，最近三年失业。
text.en: Has spent the seven years moving around Britain, unemployed for the last three of them.

text.zh: 他说自己并不比任何人强，只是一个有自己特殊困难和障碍的人。
text.en: Says he is not better than anybody, just somebody with his own particular difficulties and obstacles.

text.zh: 上过当地综合中学和阿伯丁大学，读了一学期就辍学。
text.en: Went to a local comprehensive and Aberdeen University, dropping out after a term.

text.zh: 靠社会救济金生活；去年执导村里的童话剧，正筹办职业巡演剧团。
text.en: Lives on Social Security; directed last year's village pantomime and is trying to organise a touring theatre company.

text.zh: 未婚；他认为找到能容忍自己的人的机会很小。
text.en: Unmarried; he thinks his chances of finding someone who would put up with him are slim.

text.zh: 住在设得兰群岛的一套政府廉租公寓。
text.en: Lives in a council flat in the Shetland Islands.

text.zh: 约两年前在设得兰群岛定居；今年未被选为童话剧导演。
text.en: Settled in the Shetland Islands a couple of years ago; this year he was not chosen to direct the pantomime.

text.zh: 担心自己会流落伦敦街头，盼望运气好能避免；他说人生还没结束。
text.en: Fears ending up wandering homeless around London, though with luck he won't; insists his life isn't over.

text.zh: 受过对外英语教学培训，并取得开放大学学士学位。
text.en: Has trained to teach English as a foreign language and gained an Open University BA.

text.zh: 在哈克尼任自由民主党区议员（无薪），完全靠国家救济生活。
text.en: An unpaid Liberal Democrat councillor in Hackney, he lives entirely on state benefit.

text.zh: 未婚；渴望与女性建立稳定关系，但从未实现。
text.en: Not married; he hankers after a stable relationship with a woman but has never achieved one.

text.zh: 住在伦敦，在哈克尼区议会任职。
text.en: Lives in London, where he serves on Hackney Council.

text.zh: 从设得兰搬到伦敦，在 Bruce 家借住两个月；1996 年当选哈克尼区议员，后连任。
text.en: Moved from Shetland to London, lodging with Bruce for two months; elected to Hackney Council in 1996 and re-elected.

text.zh: 被问到现在是否是人生好时光，他说从没这么忙过，也从没接触过这么多人。
text.en: Asked if this is a good time in his life, he says he has never been busier or in contact with so many people.

text.zh: 完成进一步培训，获卡莱尔主教重新授予平信徒读经员资格。
text.en: Completed further training and was re-licensed as a lay reader by the Bishop of Carlisle.

text.zh: 任坎布里亚自由民主党区议员，并竞选郡议员；每周一天在乐施会做义工。
text.en: Liberal Democrat district councillor in Cumbria, standing for the county council; volunteers one day a week for Oxfam.

text.zh: 从未结婚，目前没有女友；曾有过一段近两年的恋情。
text.en: Has never married and has no girlfriend; he once had a girlfriend for nearly two years.

text.zh: 住在英格兰西北部坎布里亚的一套前政府公寓。
text.en: Lives in a former council flat in Cumbria, in North West England.

text.zh: 2000 年辞去哈克尼议席，迁居坎布里亚，2003 年当选伊登区沙普选区议员；父亲去世。
text.en: Resigned his Hackney seat in 2000, moved to Cumbria, won Shap ward on Eden District Council in 2003; his father died.

text.zh: 他说自己能在长久关系中快乐，但为没发生的事后悔或愤怒毫无意义。
text.en: Says he could be happy in a lasting relationship, but sees little point in regret or anger over what hasn't happened.

text.zh: 任坎布里亚自由民主党议员，津贴微薄，兼任平信徒牧师；始终找不到有薪工作。
text.en: Liberal Democrat councillor in Cumbria on a derisory allowance and a licensed lay minister; he has found no paid career.

text.zh: 独居；他说谈过几段恋爱，但都没有持续下去。
text.en: Lives alone; he says he has had several relationships, but none has lasted.

text.zh: 住在英格兰西北部的坎布里亚。
text.en: Lives in Cumbria, in North West England.

text.zh: 2006 年应邀赴澳大利亚演讲；2010 年参选卡莱尔选区国会议员，名列第三。
text.en: Was invited to Australia in 2006 to give a talk; stood for Parliament in Carlisle in 2010, finishing third.

text.zh: 他说人在不自知时最快乐，比如与老朋友轻松吃饭或散步聊天。
text.en: Says people are happiest when unaware of it, such as over a relaxed meal or a walk with old friends.

text.zh: 任郡议员，收入足以维持生活，不再领救济；最近重获英格兰教会读经员资格。
text.en: A county councillor whose pay covers his needs, so he no longer claims benefits; recently re-licensed as a Church of England reader.

text.zh: 已婚，但幸福四年多后与妻子已很少见面；父母均已去世。
text.en: Married, but after four-plus happy years he and his wife now rarely see each other; both his parents have died.

text.zh: 仍住在坎布里亚，但在法国买了一栋房子。
text.en: Still lives in Cumbria but has bought a house in France.

text.zh: 结婚；用母亲的部分遗产在法国买房；2013、2017 年当选坎布里亚郡议会伊登湖区议员。
text.en: Married; bought a house in France partly with his mother's legacy; elected to Cumbria County Council (Eden Lakes) in 2013 and 2017.

text.zh: 议会或教会工作办成事时他就快乐，但遗憾自己作为作家毫无成就。
text.en: Happy when something goes right through council or church work, but regrets having had no success as a writer.

text.zh: 已退休；每周在法国一家书店做半天义工。
text.en: Has retired; he volunteers half a day a week in a bookshop in France.

text.zh: 与妻子仍有婚姻关系但已分居；这段婚姻实际只维持了四年。
text.en: Still married but separated from his wife; the marriage was active for only four years.

text.zh: 独自住在法国，就是他多年来度假时去的那栋房子。
text.en: Lives alone in France, in the house he visited on holiday for many years.

text.zh: 2019 年大选参选沃金顿选区，名列第四；已退休并从坎布里亚迁居法国。
text.en: Stood for Workington at the 2019 general election, finishing fourth; has retired and moved from Cumbria to France.
A former local councillor and lay preacher, he has retired and lives alone in France, separated from his wife; he says he is as happy as he can be given his life.
text.zh: 曾任地方议员和平信徒传道人，现已退休，与妻子分居，独自住在法国；他说以他的人生而言，这已是他能有的最大快乐。
